bet.title: NVDA vs NHY — total return showdown
bet.stake: Loser buys a full night at Le Benjamin
bet.measure: Total return, including cash dividends, each leg in its own currency. No FX conversion.

settlementRule.countdownMeaning: 21 November 2026, 16:00 America/New_York, the instant hardcoded in the original countdown.
settlementRule.why: 21 November 2026 was a Saturday, so neither Nasdaq nor Oslo printed a close that day. Settlement uses the last official close on or before that instant: Friday 20 November 2026. Both listings traded that session.
settlementRule.dividendWindow: Ex-dividend dates strictly after the 21 November 2025 strike close and on or before the 20 November 2026 settlement close. A buyer at the strike close does not receive a dividend that goes ex that same day. A dividend going ex on the settlement date would count, because the shares were held through the previous close. None fell on the settlement date.
settlementRule.priceField: indicators.quote[0].close — the unadjusted session close. adjclose was not used, because dividends are added in cash. Using the adjusted close as well would count dividends twice.
settlementRule.rounding: Closes are the Yahoo prints rounded half-up to the cent, which is how both names quote. Those cent prices are the ones in the return. They match the strikes the bet was struck at ($178.88 and 70.54 NOK).

source.name: Yahoo Finance chart API
source.otherSources: Stooq was requested as a second source and returned a bot-check page rather than prices, so it is not cited. No figure below was typed in by hand. Splits in the window: none on either name.

nhy.exDateNote: On the Oslo listing the close went from 106.55 NOK on 7 May 2026 to 104.00 NOK on 8 May 2026, the morning Yahoo marks as the 3.00 NOK ex-date. That gap is consistent with a cash dividend but is the same source, not an independent one.

result.marginDefinition: NHY total return minus NVDA total return
result.pays: THE CLAW buys a full night at Le Benjamin
